long_pdf.method: Four real open fonts; 97/193-character 20pt stroke and filled-Bezier PDFs with original advances. Normal Converter resource loading. Same original PDF bytes as rc27; compare the saved rc27 recognition baseline. The converter sampling count is stabilized; runtime matching and r2 catalogs are unchanged. Every glyph is checked against original font cmap/BoundsPen at its PDF position, with complete source handles/digests and saved TEXT insertion/alignment endpoints. Font files are used only to generate/audit fixtures, never by runtime recognition.

geometry.method: Same PDF bytes. Compare original modelspace handles and tags after removing only recovery annotations/TEXT. Every differing entity must be a HATCH with unchanged attributes, provenance, closed contour count; compare full Shapely LineString boundaries bidirectionally. No saved-DXF geometry rewrite is applied.

short_dxf.method: Fresh recovery on the same persisted DXF inputs with all ten r2 catalogs loaded by the rc28 algorithm. Compare every existing recognition report field (the two added long-text counters are both zero) and every entitydb tag (except the validated ezdxf writer timestamp) against rc26 outputs, including original geometry, recovered TEXT, blocks and resources. Catalogs are loaded once and reused; separate full PDF conversions exercise normal uncached loading. Not a rerun of 84 PDFs.

matching_face_pdf.method: Each published glyph label/source handles and bbox checked against original font cmap/BoundsPen excluding move-only contours without any segments at the PDF generation position; original DXF entity tags compared to rc23 in all cases after removing only recovery layer/XDATA. No source fonts used by runtime matching.
